stem: A barangay office has a budget for supplies. By December, it has used 100% of that budget. How much of the budget has it used?
hints: Percent means "out of 100". Think of the budget as 100 equal parts.
If you use 100 of the 100 parts, how many parts are left? Pick the choice that matches.

steps.action: Think of the budget as 100 equal parts.
steps.why: Percent means out of 100, so 100 parts make the whole.

steps.action: 100 out of 100 parts is every part, so nothing is left.
The office has used all of its budget.

trapNotes.Half of it: Half is 50 out of 100, which is 50%. 100% means all 100 parts.
trapNotes.A tenth of it: A tenth is 10 out of 100, which is 10%. 100% means all 100 parts.
trapNotes.A quarter of it: A quarter is 25 out of 100, which is 25%. 100% means all 100 parts.
